milestone: The revenue chain is finished on the software side and independently re-verified this cycle: one honest way to record a real customer, one pass that either produces a complete priced ask or names exactly what is missing, and one operator screen where zero reads as zero.
readiness: Built, tested and re-verified end to end against the real dependency tree. Sending, signing and charging remain deliberate human steps - the software is built so it cannot do them by itself. Publishing to the web stays a deliberate manual step by the operator, never automatic.
headline: ARIA / AXIS is in active build. This cycle re-verified the finished revenue chain first-hand rather than trusting the previous report: every gate green, effective full-suite pass. What is still missing is not software - it is a real named customer and one human click. Revenue received to date: none, stated plainly.
note: Public status headline only. Detailed build state is operator-internal and served only to authenticated operators inside the AXIS command center.
